title: 馬克白 1-4 立儲
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, dark fantasy atmosphere
characters: Macbeth, a broad-shouldered warrior in dark plate armor, shoulder-length black hair, short black beard, a pale diagonal scar across his left cheek

panels.prompt: interior of a medieval Scottish palace hall at Forres, banners and torches, elderly King Duncan with a long white beard, gold crown, fur-trimmed deep blue robe seated on a throne, courtiers below

dialogue.speaker: 鄧肯
dialogue.text: 考特的死刑，執行完畢了嗎？

panels.prompt: young prince Malcolm, clean-shaven, short fair hair, thin gold circlet, reporting to the throne with a solemn face

dialogue.speaker: 馬爾康
dialogue.text: 他坦白認罪，深切悔恨，從容就死——他一生行事，沒有比臨終時更得體的了。
dialogue.en: Nothing in his life became him like the leaving it.

panels.prompt: elderly King Duncan with a long white beard gazing down ruefully, while in the background {characters} enters the hall through a great doorway

dialogue.speaker: 鄧肯
dialogue.text: 世上沒有一種方法，能從一個人的臉上探察他的居心。他是我絕對信任過的人……
dialogue.en: There's no art to find the mind's construction in the face: he was a gentleman on whom I built an absolute trust.

panels.prompt: elderly King Duncan with a long white beard, gold crown, stepping down from his throne to clasp the shoulders of {characters}, warm torchlight

dialogue.speaker: 鄧肯
dialogue.text: 最值得欽佩的表弟！你的功勞太超越尋常，飛得最快的報酬都追不上你。
dialogue.en: O worthiest cousin! ... More is thy due than more than all can pay.

panels.prompt: {characters} kneeling with his head bowed before the king, beside him Banquo, a sturdy warrior with a thick braided beard, a raven feather pinned at his shoulder, standing at ease

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 為陛下盡忠效命，它本身就是酬報。
dialogue.en: The service and the loyalty I owe, in doing it, pays itself.

dialogue.speaker: 鄧肯
dialogue.text: 尊貴的班柯，你的功勞也不在他之下——讓我把你擁抱在心頭。
dialogue.en: Noble Banquo, that hast no less deserved... let me infold thee and hold thee to my heart.

panels.prompt: elderly King Duncan with a long white beard, gold crown, raising the hand of young prince Malcolm, clean-shaven, short fair hair, thin gold circlet, before the assembled court, trumpets and banners

dialogue.speaker: 鄧肯
dialogue.text: 我向你們宣布——立長子馬爾康為儲君，冊封肯勃蘭親王！
dialogue.en: We will establish our estate upon our eldest, Malcolm, whom we name hereafter the Prince of Cumberland.

panels.prompt: close-up of {characters} frozen mid-bow among the applauding courtiers, his eyes sunk in shadow while his mouth keeps a courteous smile

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 讓我先行一步回去，把陛下光臨的喜訊報告我的妻子。就此告辭。
dialogue.en: I'll be myself the harbinger, and make joyful the hearing of my wife with your approach.

panels.prompt: {characters} standing alone in a dark palace courtyard at night, a sky full of cold stars above him, his long shadow stretching toward the viewer, half his face swallowed by darkness

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白（內心）
dialogue.text: 肯勃蘭親王！這是橫在我前路的一塊階石——我得跳過去，不然就栽在它上面。
dialogue.en: The Prince of Cumberland! That is a step on which I must fall down, or else o'erleap, for in my way it lies.

quote.text: 星星啊，收起你們的火焰，別讓光照見我黑暗的欲望
quote.en: Stars, hide your fires; let not light see my black and deep desires.

panels.prompt: back in the warm bright hall, elderly King Duncan with a long white beard laughing with Banquo, a sturdy warrior with a thick braided beard, both unaware, wine cups raised

dialogue.speaker: 鄧肯
dialogue.text: 真是英勇非凡的國戚！他先回去替我們預備款待了——跟上去吧。
dialogue.en: It is a peerless kinsman. ... Let's after him, whose care is gone before to bid us welcome.
